bioghist.head: Historical Information
bioghist.p: Established by an Act of Assembly in 1976, the Dept. of Planning and Budget was created through the merging of the Division of the Budget and the Division of State Planning and Community Affairs. The duties of the Dept. of Planning and Budget include: the development and direction of an integrated policy analysis, planning and budgeting process within State government; the development, storage, retrieval and dissemination of data on the social, economic, physical and governmental aspects of the State; the formulation of an executive budget; conduct policy and program analysis for the Governor; the establishment of planning districts and standard metropolitan statistical areas; and the development and operation of a system of standardized reports of program and financial performance for management.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Reports of the Virginia Dept. of Planning and Budget (DPB), 1987-2004, include various publications and reports created by other entities and collected by DPB. Contains reports created by the Council on Information Management, Dept. of Information Management, Governor's Commission on Information Technology, Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission, and the Virginia Information Technologies Agency.

This collection also includes several VHS tapes containing interviews with former Governors of Virginia related for Virginia's Secretarial System, as well as several other miscellaneous tapes. The interview tapes are also available electronically (mp4).
